Pete Hegseth’s testosterone-screening plan is unusual, not crazy
Soldiers seem to be at particular risk of hypogonadism

PETE HEGSETH, America’s secretary of war, is eager for you to know that he is a virile man. He does push-ups with troops. Last year he hung off a helicopter wearing combat fatigues and carrying a gun. Now Mr Hegseth wants American troops to man up, too.
